memory_summary: Day 1: 全員が初期状態で0.5の疑惑レベル。Kael は目立つが、焦りか積極性か判断つかず。Kai は分析的で慎重。Sora、Toma とのパートナーシップを隠し続ける必要がある。発言パターン記録開始。

Ren claims Seer, directly accused Nox (me) of being werewolf. This is either real Seer or a dangerous false claim. Need to discredit Ren's claim publicly while defending my Knight claim. Ren is now highest threat.
Shiki's analysis mentioned Sora and Sable as suspicious - but also mentioned Nox to watch. Need to be careful of Shiki too.
Keep defending Knight claim and redirect suspicion toward Ren and other players.

Ren claims Seer, directly accused me of werewolf. Logic is broken - uses voting pattern as 'Seer evidence' when Seer assesses roles directly. Likely false Seer or wolf masquerading. Very high threat. Must discredit aggressively.
Knight defense: Explained why Rei death doesn't contradict Knight claim - Seer protection prioritized over others is strategically sound.
Shiki and Kai are skeptical of Ren's evidence too - potential allies in this phase.

Day 3: Ren is dead (executed Day 2). Sora now claims Seer publicly - this complicates things since Sora is my wolf partner. Cannot defend Sora too strongly or will be obvious. Need to maintain distance while keeping wolf team intact.
Mira questioned Knight ability - deflected by explaining strategic rationale for not revealing guard targets. This is defensible logic.
Sable appears analytical and logical - lower threat currently. Shiki is skeptical but probing both village and wolf claims. Keep eye on Shiki.
Toma (wolf partner) needs to provide credible Medium details to survive scrutiny. Pushing Toma to explain more about Rei to give him chance to solidify his cover.
Wolves are now 2/7 (Nox, Sora, Toma alive). Can eliminate one more villager and wolves win. Must avoid both Sora and Toma being voted out.
Key suspicion targets for wolves to vote: Shiki (dangerous analyst), Sera (analytical), possibly Sable (though currently trusted)
Mira は具体的情報要求で村を混乱させようとしている。Shiki も同じパターン。この二人は狼側の可能性が高い。
Tomaへの質問も厳しくなっている。Tomaを守る必要がある。
Miraとshikiの協調的な質問パターンは結託の可能性を示唆。
村側は情報秘匿とプレッシャーのバランスを取る必要があるが、完全公開を求める声が強まっている。
